title: Policy Fee, Tax Base and Payment Terms of Excess Flood Policies
content:
Each term of an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy carries an annual policy fee, fully earned at binding. The tier table below states the fee, whether the surplus lines tax and the stamping fee apply to the policy fee as well as to the premium, and whether payment must be made in full.

| Tier | Excess Flood 250K | Excess Flood 500K | Excess Flood 1M | Excess Flood 2M | Excess Flood 3M | Excess Flood 5M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual policy fee, fully earned at binding (USD) | 150 | 150 | 150 | 150 | 150 | 150 |
| Surplus lines tax and stamping fee apply to the policy fee as well as the premium | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Full term premium, fee and taxes due at binding and at renewal | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Basis questions answered

**Is the policy fee part of the taxable amount?** Yes, on every tier: the surplus lines tax and the stamping fee are figured on the term premium plus the policy fee.

**Can a term be paid in installments?** No tier offers it; the whole term premium, the policy fee and the taxes are due at binding and at renewal.

**Does the fee come back on a cancellation?** The fee is fully earned at binding.
